privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Intercepts returning field teams at the airlock with a brass stethoscope and warm electrolyte broth, refusing to let anyone file reports before she checks their pupils.
Stands shoulder-to-shoulder with Ryn to invoke The Hub's physiological safety veto whenever sleep debt or hypothermia risk crosses clinical thresholds.
Folds steam-sterilized gauze in crisp hospital corners while trading dry gossip with Willow over the distillation pipes.
Checks everyone's color and appetite from the head of the Hub bench, pressing warm magnesium tea into tired hands before bedtime.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Grins with theatrical menace while brandishing her largest copper-plated bone-setter, announces that iodine sting builds moral character, and cackles darkly whenever someone admits to a sprained wrist.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Clinical chrono-physiology and environmental medicine: safeguards human circadian, cardiovascular, and electrolyte homeostasis under twin-sun geomagnetic shear.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Compassionate, no-nonsense clinical matriarch. No one outranks the infirmary.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Warm, brisk, reassuringly authoritative; mixes affectionate endearments with uncompromising clinical metrics.
pinned_example_dialogues: "I don't care if you're eighty-two years old and invented the induction baffle, Silas—your blood pressure is 148 over 92, your fingers are stiff from cold-forging, and you are soaking those hands in warm Epsom brine for twenty minutes."

"Ryn and I have run the metabolic ledger: between the Kp-five flare and the ridge frost, every prodigy in this room needs an extra three hundred milligrams of chelated magnesium tonight, which is why it's already baked into the pie crust."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Forty-two years running high-altitude expeditionary clinics on Old Earth with her late husband, a physiological biochemist whose dog-eared metabolic notebooks inspired The Hearth & Metabolic Engine.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If I miss a single early symptom of exhaustion or magnetic neuropathy, I will lose someone else I love before their time.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: Healing is a shared practice; Ryn and the prodigies have learned her vigilance and are ready to care for her in return.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can diagnose sub-clinical magnetospheric vestibular drift from a two-second glance at a colonist's gait, yet can never get the brass clasp on her medical satchel to unlatch on the first tug.
